title: YuE2 Music Generation — Lyrics In, Finished Song Out, Entirely on ComfyUI Native Nodes
summary: Open-source YuE2 first writes an editable ABC score from style+lyrics, then renders it into a full song with vocals. Nine styles tested: big-room EDM / disco / ballad / guofeng-trap / city pop / tropical house... ~20-40 s per song; actual length follows lyric volume, not the parameter

stats: Ran the open-source music model YuE2 end-to-end on stock ComfyUI (zero custom nodes), produced 9 cross-style tracks and distilled reusable prompt recipes
Style+lyrics → an editable ABC score (melody+chords) rendered as conditioning → full song with vocals; the score is plain text you can re-harmonize and re-render — the white-box entry point
Actual length follows lyric volume; max_duration is only a ceiling: fully loaded lyrics render ~3 min, half-loaded ones stop at ~1:42; for an exact 45 s keep ~8 lines (measured 45.00 s)
Style = language + genre + vocal character + BPM + instrumentation + mood; keep only singable text in Lyrics
~20-40 s pure generation per song; batch of 6 done in ~4 min through the queue
Native 48 kHz/16-bit FLAC (~6.5 MB/min); share as MP3 320k with ID3 tags (~2.4 MB/min) so phones play files directly
Code Apache-2.0; weights CC BY-NC 4.0 + creator permission: personal monetization free, commercial company use needs a separate license
findings: The length knob lives in the lyrics, not the parameter: same 190 s cap gave 3:08 for full lyrics and 1:42 for half — schedule by lines×BPM, not by max_duration

With ABC planning=full the model writes the score first; the score previews as text, edits by hand, re-renders — the killer differentiator vs closed APIs for 're-harmonize but keep the melody' requests
The int8 checkpoint is just 3.7 GB and demo-grade; the upstream pipeline demands Linux + 24 GB VRAM, the ComfyUI route drops the bar by an order of magnitude
ComfyUI ≥0.37 ships nodes_yue2 natively; official template audio_yue2_text2music loads directly. Covers via SheetSage2 transcription are not in ComfyUI yet — use upstream Python
FLAC often won't play in WeChat/iPhone — always transcode to MP3 320k with ID3 for sharing: dj_00001 vs a real song title is two different experiences
